text.en: Asha asked how India talks with other countries. "Through foreign policy," said the teacher.

Foreign policy is how a country deals with others. India's foreign policy is guided by the principles of peace, non-alignment, respect for sovereignty and cooperation. Jawaharlal Nehru shaped its early form with the Panchsheel principles.
India follows the Non-Aligned Movement, supports the United Nations and works for disarmament and against colonialism and apartheid. It has good relations with neighbours and the world and believes in 'the world is one family'.
India stays strong with an independent policy, and its relations with major powers and its neighbours matter for trade and peace. The Ministry of External Affairs carries out the foreign policy.
